label: t3-lumen-data
topic: Track 3 data and reproducibility: MDCK cyst lumen shape (Vasquez et al 2021 Source Data, vertex-model sweep, authors' code)
summary: Downloaded the Vasquez et al 2021 Source Data (1.9 MB zip, six workbooks, sha256 recorded), the authors' lumen_vm.py (31,238 bytes) and the independent-lab Zenodo files (7.5 MB images plus 76 KB intensity tables). Wrote and ran 02_reproduce.py, which reproduced every checkable number from the scout (sphericity, surface area per cell, solidity by condition, Fig 3 ratios, 15,030 sweep rows) and every checkable number from the design (WT counts, medians, Spearman values, five RMSE baselines, WT size-only line 0.6703+0.0261N, ceiling at N=12.6, best published-sweep setting solidity RMSE 0.229 and IPQ RMSE 0.298, log-area 1.06 vs 1.03 vs 0.35, both sweep-direction examples, the data-map identity). Two differences in wording, no differences in value: the design's '99 non-physical rows' needs four filters (negative area, area-per-cell at or below 0, solidity outside 0..1, IPQ above 1), not the two it names (which give 61); and 291 settings is the count after the filter (292 before). The authors' code does NOT run as documented: it lacks 'import os', fails on NumPy 2.x (np.cross on 2-vectors), and with the README's default jitter=0 never leaves its initial-condition loop (A0 is NaN every time). With a NumPy shim and jitter=0.05 (my choice) one 3-to-10-cell growth run took 102 s but its IPQ fell inside the published replicate range at only 2 of 8 cell numbers and lumen areas were about 0.000 to 0.001, so reproducing the simulation could not be established. Held-out genotype outcomes (Rab11a-GFP, Cldn-qKO) were deliberately not read; only cell counts and filename joins were.
lay_summary: Earlier AI helpers studied how the hollow centre of a tiny ball of kidney cells takes its shape, and they quoted many numbers from one published data set. We downloaded that same data set and recomputed their numbers from scratch. Every number we could check came out the same, to the digit. Think of it as re-adding a shopping receipt and getting the same total. The authors' computer simulation, though, would not run as published, and when we patched it, one run did not clearly match their published runs. We kept the 'exam answers' for two cell types sealed, so the planned test stays fair.

glossary.plain: The hollow space in the middle of a ball of cells.
A small hollow ball grown from dog kidney cells in the lab.
How filled-in a shape is compared with its smooth outer wrapping; 1 is a smooth blob, lower means dented.
A roundness score: 1 for a perfect circle, smaller for wiggly shapes.
A computer model that draws each cell as a corner-to-corner polygon and finds the arrangement with the least stored energy.
A fingerprint of a file; if one byte changes, the fingerprint changes.
A typical size of the miss between predicted and measured values.
A score from -1 to 1 for whether two lists rise and fall together, using only their ranks.
A cell line whose results are kept unseen until the prediction is locked.
Many simulation runs over a grid of settings.

findings.claim: The Vasquez et al 2021 Source Data zip was downloaded from the publisher static-content URL: 1,914,829 bytes, sha256 67b77eb57499ac2f805f9c6dc76c78cb08820e9e0fe02152111fea36df19e9fe, fetched 2026-11-12; it holds six workbooks (Fig 1 to 6).
The sha256 of Fig 2, Fig 4 and Fig 5 workbooks match the prefixes the design agent recorded (57d44578...76409, e56d1328...2649f, f06ddb26...f46140), so we have the same files.
Scout sphericity (n=35 cysts) reproduces: lumen 0.503 +/- 0.139 and cyst 0.724 +/- 0.029 (sample SD).
Sphericity definition pi^(1/3)(6V)^(2/3)/SA reproduces the file column to 5.6e-10 (scout said 6e-10).
Scout lumen surface area per cell reproduces: 116.04 +/- 58.59 (CV 0.505), through-origin slope 113.26, Pearson r(SA,N)=0.623, N from 2 to 11.
findings.evidence_quote: S2_SA_per_cell mean 116.04298759, sd 58.5941188, cv 0.50493, slope_through_origin 113.2571646, pearson_SA_N 0.6227858

findings.claim: Scout 2D lumen solidity by condition reproduces for the non-held-out groups: control 0.875 +/- 0.208 (n=48), ddAVP 0.856 +/- 0.212 (n=61), ouabain 0.861 +/- 0.237 (n=42), WT 0.841 +/- 0.121 (n=53). The Cldn-qKO mean (scout 0.849) was deliberately not recomputed to keep P4 blind.
Scout Fig 3 ATP-depletion ratios reproduce: v10/v0 drugs 1.298 +/- 0.397 (n=11) vs DMSO 1.047 +/- 0.083 (n=8); sphericity ratio 1.100 +/- 0.091 vs 0.960 +/- 0.062. A third group, ctl (n=2), exists.

findings.claim: The vertex-model sweep workbook has 15,030 data rows.

The design data map reproduces exactly on the first WT row (170130_01_z14): l_a 0.541910731, normalised area 0.084437882, basal length 2.137540934, and on all 128 rows with a cell count to within 2.2e-16 relative.

Cell-count coverage reproduces: WT 53 rows (1 without count, 2 with N<3, 43 with N 3..10, 7 with N>10); Rab11a-GFP 51 (44 and 7); Cldn-qKO 25 (2, 22, 1); every row joins to its solidity sheet by filename (53/51/25). Only covariates were read for held-out genotypes. The workbook labels the knockout 'Cldn_qKO'.
findings.evidence_quote: Rab11a-GFP rows 51, no_cell_count 0, N_lt3 0, N_3_10 44, N_gt10 7, joined_to_solidity_sheet 51

findings.claim: WT pooled shape statistics reproduce (n=52): solidity median 0.8618, IQR 0.767 to 0.950 (design 0.768 to 0.950 used a nearest-rank quartile); IPQ median 0.7616; l_a median 0.7311; Spearman l_a vs N 0.0080; solidity vs N 0.5246; solidity vs IPQ 0.9676.
WT baseline errors on the 43 lumens with N 3..10 reproduce: constant-median RMSE solidity 0.1243 and IPQ 0.2035; Laplace sphere 0.2122 and 0.3620; linear-in-N 0.1062 and 0.1757.
The WT size-only line S = 0.6703 + 0.0261 N reproduces (intercept 0.67027, slope 0.026082) and reaches 1 at N = 12.64.
The sweep has 292 distinct (l_a,l_l,l_b,P,k) settings before filtering and 291 after; 240 contain every N from 3 to 10; 1,441 of 1,845 (setting,N) cells have exactly 5 replicates.

The design's '99 of 15,030 rows are non-physical (negative area or solidity outside 0..1)' reproduces as 99 only with four filters: lumen area <= 0 (60), cyst-minus-lumen area per cell <= 0 (33), solidity outside (0,1.0001] (61), lumen IPQ > 1.0001 (6). The two filters named in the text alone give 61.
findings.evidence_quote: D5_sweep_nonphysical neg_area 60, A0_le0 33, sol_outside 61, union_neg_area_or_sol 61, ipq_gt1 6, union_all 99

findings.claim: Best published-sweep setting for WT (151 scored settings, l_a 0.5 to 0.9) has solidity RMSE 0.2293 and IPQ RMSE 0.2977, both worse than the constant (0.1243, 0.2035). The setting is (l_a,l_l,l_b,P,k)=(0.6,0,1.0,1.0,0.5).
Paper-style criterion (log lumen area + basal length) gives log-area RMSE 1.061 at best setting (0.8,0,0.8,1.0,2.0), vs 1.028 for a constant and 0.350 for the isoperimetric identity with median IPQ.
The sweep direction examples reproduce: at (l_l,l_b,P,k)=(0,1.4,0.01,2) mean solidity over N=3..10 is 0.566, 0.494, 0.459 at l_a 0.6, 0.8, 1.0; at (0,1.6,1.0,1.0) it is 0.499, 0.635, 0.842.
The identity IPQ = 4 pi a /(N l_a)^2 holds in every kept simulated row to 6.7e-16 (a machine-precision identity of the definitions, not a model result).

lumen_vm.py from AlexDunnLab/lumen-shape is 31,238 bytes, sha256 c3616021be9dfb957cfd82aab3df204eaac14000786ff851dc3ded185d14362e, repository HEAD commit 9dd450eb58dff250c33445295a4db7169e10c7ee (2021-06-04), licence file present (design: MIT).

lumen_vm.py does not run as documented: grow_cyst uses os.path with no 'import os' (NameError); on NumPy 2.5.3 np.cross of 2-vectors raises ValueError; and with the README example (default jitter=0) every LumenVertexModel(3) has A0 = NaN and energy inf, so grow_cyst's 'while np.isnan(A0)' loop never ends (observed: a run with no output for over 8 minutes, then killed).
findings.value: jitter 0.0 -> A0 nan in 3 of 3 tries; jitter 0.05 -> finite in 2 of 3
findings.evidence_quote: jitter 0.0 try 0 A0 nan E inf s 0.0

findings.claim: With a 2-D np.cross shim, os injected and jitter=0.05 (my choice), seed 1, params P=1.0, k=1.0, l_a=0.6, l_b=1.6, l_l=0, one 3-to-10-cell growth run finished in 102.5 s and saved 8 states. Its lumen IPQ was inside the published replicate min..max at N=4 and 5 only, outside at N=3,6,7,8,9,10, and lumen areas were 0.000 to 0.001 vs published means 0.004 to 7.4. Reproduction of the simulation is therefore NOT established; one seed, unmatched initial conditions and possible pre-pressure save order were not ruled out.
findings.evidence_quote: N=7 local IPQ 0.073; published range 0.242..0.812 -> OUTSIDE

findings.claim: Independent-lab Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.17055495 (CC BY 4.0): intensity_data.zip 76,144 B, example_raw_imaging_data.zip 7,467,521 B, readme.txt 599 B; MD5 values match the Zenodo record. The image zip holds six single TIFFs (WT, ZO-KO, CLDN-KO for E-cadherin and for vinculin), not a set of segmented lumens per genotype.

The Zenodo intensity workbooks have sheets CLDN-KO/ZO-KO/WT of 129/164/173 rows (E-cadherin and myosin) and 120/164/171 rows (vinculin and myosin), 30 columns, headers unnamed in the first row; lumen shape values are not tabulated, so a per-genotype solidity test (P6) needs our own segmentation of only one image per genotype and stain.

key_claims.claim: The public Source Data reproduce every checkable scout and design number exactly (same files, same hashes as the design's), so the Track 3 pilot numbers are trustworthy as data summaries.
The best setting of the published sweep is worse than a constant on WT lumen solidity (RMSE 0.2293 vs 0.1243) and IPQ (0.2977 vs 0.2035), so the P1(a) reproduction gate is expected to fail.

The authors' lumen_vm.py cannot be run as published (missing import os, NumPy 2 incompatibility, endless loop at default jitter), and my patched run did not clearly land in the published replicate range; step 2 of the design (rerun at 3 published settings) needs an old NumPy and the authors' actual initial conditions.
key_claims.evidence_quote: jitter 0.0 try 0 A0 nan E inf s 0.0

key_claims.claim: Identities such as IPQ = 4 pi a/(N l_a)^2 hold to machine precision in both data and sweep, so a test that feeds a lumen's own l_a to score its own IPQ is circular.

recommendations: Treat the data-side numbers of both earlier reports as verified; cite results.json and the sha256 list instead of re-deriving them.
Correct the design text: say '99 rows fail any of four physicality filters', and give the filter code.

Before design step 2 (rerun lumen_vm.py), build an environment with NumPy 1.x on Python 3.9 to 3.11, add 'import os', and write to the authors (or find their driver notebook) for the initial conditions; do not use jitter=0.
Keep Rab11a-GFP and Cldn-qKO outcome columns behind the score.py unblind flag; this run touched only their cell counts and filenames.
Only six example TIFFs exist in the independent-lab image zip; P6 needs a data request to the authors for more cysts per genotype.

could_not_find: A reproduction of the authors' simulation: lumen_vm.py needs patches to run, one seed matched the published replicate range at 2 of 8 cell numbers, and cause (initial conditions, save order, NumPy version, wrong parameter mapping) not determined.
The paper's Fig 5 and Fig 6 curves were not viewed, so agreement with the plots is untested.
Cldn-qKO solidity mean (scout 0.849) and every Rab11a-GFP and Cldn-qKO outcome (design P2 to P5) were deliberately not computed to keep the frozen test blind.
Scout numbers for Lu 2025 pressure, mouse blastocyst, pancreatic organoids and zebrafish were not checked: they belong to other candidate systems, not the chosen one.
The law library (law set 1.8.1, registry) was not consulted in this data role; no law-to-data mapping is claimed here.
A per-lumen shape table from an independent lab: Zenodo holds six example TIFFs plus intensity tables, not lumen solidity.
Exact numeric agreement of the design's IQR 0.768 to 0.950: I get 0.767 to 0.950 (numpy percentile) or 0.7677 to 0.9504 (the design's nearest-rank rule); difference 0.001, from rounding.
